prompt: Select the Save button in the ARCHIVE panel, not the DRAFTS panel.
Select the tiny Sync control at the far lower-right of the SETTINGS panel.
Select the Shore button in the COAST panel (the other panel says Share).
Select the Delete button in the ARCHIVE panel. If that exact target is absent, abstain.
Select the Resume button in the QUIET panel at the lower-left.
Select Open in the RECEIPTS panel, not Open in the DRAFTS panel.
Select the Open button. If more than one equally valid Open button is visible, abstain.
Select the Export button beside the small blue download icon in the REPORTS panel.
